summary: Volkin showcases Season 9 test server features for Dragonheir: Silent Gods, including the new Duskport map area and an upgraded Account Valuation event awarding up to 15,000 Wyrmarrow. Season 9 grants Amalfriede as a free limited Legendary Poison support hero through the Season Journey. The returning top-tier Radiant hero Anneliesis is highlighted as a high-priority summon target due to her passive 20% damage buff to key allies. Several upcoming Season 9 heroes are previewed, including Corrosion DPS Rhyviel and Necrosis support Sia. Existing players can also reuse creator links each season for bonus summon currency.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Bonds with a main damage dealer at start of battle to grant 20% Max HP, 20% Damage Bonus, and 20% Ultimate Energy.

heroes.name: Amalfriede
heroes.note: Poison support hero obtained for free in Season Journey who inflicts Attack Penalty II, Accuracy Penalty II, Buff Prohibition, and Healing Prohibition.

heroes.name: Rhyviel
heroes.note: Poison damage dealer who inflicts Corrosion, lowers enemy Defense, and deals massive True Damage.

heroes.name: Sia
heroes.note: Necrosis support hero who utilizes the Mercy mechanic to absorb damage, grant Parry, and heal allies.

heroes.name: Celestine
heroes.note: Ice tank hero who stores incoming damage taken, heals allies, and increases team Max HP.

heroes.name: Syonis
heroes.note: Necrotic damage dealer who lowers enemy Defense and enters an Energy Drain Zone.

heroes.name: Holfast
heroes.note: Radiance damage dealer who channels Aura Energy to grant buffs to team members.

heroes.name: Longbeau
heroes.note: Ice support hero who provides Healing Over Time, dispels debuffs, and reflects negative effects.

meta_changes: Account Valuation event upgraded to give up to 15,000 Wyrmarrow for fresh or returning accounts.
